previous_heldout.note: Seeds 4-6: the held-out sets of the previous round. Their results were read in detail during development (no rule or threshold was changed afterwards), so they are no longer untouched; re-scored here with the current code.

unseen.note: Scenario families written after the rules were fixed and committed before generation (synthetic/unseen_scenarios.js); never used for tuning. Same author as the rules: less template leakage, not less author bias. Clean jobs are included as the normal base rate.
